channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Cury diz que Senado deve discutir impeachment e defende STF com nove ministros
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) advocates for Senate discussions on impeachment requests against Supreme Court justices and proposes reducing the court's composition from 11 to 9 members.

item.title: Espero que a consciência de Cármen Lúcia fale mais alto, diz Zema
item.description: Zema criticized Moraes and other STF ministers, asking Cármen Lúcia's conscience to prevail over the 'corporate spirit' of the court. He attended a Paulista event and questioned Moraes' relationship with banker Vorcaro. Flávio Bolsonaro also demonstrated with attacks against the minister.

item.title: Decisão nas mãos de Moraes tira Michelle de ato de Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro will not attend Flávio Bolsonaro's event on Avenida Paulista due to a decision by Alexandre de Moraes, who has not yet approved her participation while the Supreme Court reviews Jair Bolsonaro's case. Her absence underscores judicial influence in political dynamics.

item.title: Cury diz ser "pesadelo" de Lula em eventual 2º turno: "Vou aposentá-lo"
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) stated in a Jovem Pan interview that he would be Lula's 'nightmare' in a potential 2026 runoff, vowing to 'retire Lula'. Cury expressed belief in a second round and chose Lula as his opponent, noting growth in polls. On the economy, he proposed financing 10 million microenterprises and splitting BNDES in the first week of government.

item.title: Zema critica Dino durante caminhada na Paulista e diz confiar em voto de Cármen Lúcia
item.description: Romeu Zema criticized Flávio Dino and expressed trust in Cármen Lúcia's vote during a campaign walk in Paulista amid the STF crisis. He also organized campaign events with criticisms of Supreme Court ministers.

item.title: Ato em Brasília pede impeachment de Moraes em meio à crise no STF
item.description: Supporters of Jair Bolsonaro gathered in Brasília to demand the impeachment of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes amid a crisis within the STF involving Justice André Mendonça as well. The demonstration brought together around 300 people and was led by figures such as Sebastião Coelho and Eduardo Girão, who emphasized the fight for freedom and criticized Moraes' actions.

item.title: Ato “Fora Lula” em BH tem “espetinho do Trump” em referência a Moraes
item.description: At a 'Fora Lula' rally in Belo Horizonte, a booth gained attention by selling 'Trump skewers' with 'Magnitsky flavor', referencing U.S. sanctions on Supreme Court justice Alexandre de Moraes. The organizer used the food stand to criticize the STF and call for new sanctions against Brazilian officials. The event gathered supporters of Jair Bolsonaro and right-wing figures from Minas Gerais.

item.title: Ato de Zema tem painel com Moraes atrás das grades na Paulista
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) held a rally on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo, displaying a giant panel depicting Minister Alexandre de Moraes behind bars with the phrase 'Enough of the Untouchables'. The event focused on criticism of the Supreme Federal Court, particularly Moraes, amid an ongoing crisis involving the minister and Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Ato do Novo em SP tem painel para apoiadores “prenderem” Moraes
item.description: At an event on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo, the Novo Party displayed a panel featuring an image of Minister Alexandre de Moraes depicted in the style of the doll from the series 'Intouchables,' allowing supporters to 'arrest' the judge in photos. The panel was used as a form of protest or criticism toward the minister during the event held on September 7, 2026.

item.title: Cury defende impeachment no STF e diz que vai revisar prisões do 8 de Janeiro e ‘aposentar Lula’
item.description: Augusto Cury advocates for the impeachment of Supreme Court justices, reducing the Court to nine members, and reviewing 8 January arrests. He claims the Legislative branch has been weak against the judiciary and that no one is above the law.

item.title: Alcolumbre, Motta, Fachin e 29 ministros vão ao desfile em Brasília
item.description: The September 7th parade in Brasília was attended by authorities such as Davi Alcolumbre, Hugo Motta, Edson Fachin, and 29 ministers, reinforcing support for President Lula's administration. The event highlighted three themes: sovereignty, protection of women, and the 2027 Women's World Cup. The cost of R$5.74 million represents a 33% increase compared to the previous year.

item.title: Michelle não vai ao ato de Flávio em SP e justifica cuidados com Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) will not attend Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign rally in São Paulo, citing the need to care for Jair Bolsonaro while awaiting a Supreme Court ruling on additional family companionship at his residence. The event, set to mobilize bolsonarismo leaders and address anti-STF themes, coincides with Jair's ongoing request to the Supreme Court for four relatives to live with him.

item.title: Rejeitado no Senado, Messias cumprimenta Alcolumbre no 7 de Setembro
item.description: The Attorney General of the Union, Jorge Messias, greeted the President of the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre, during the September 7th parade, following his rejection for a position at the STF. The official participated in the ceremony with other leaders from the three branches of government, including President Lula, the STF, and the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Flávio usa 7 de Setembro para medir força eleitoral na Paulista
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will hold a campaign rally on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo on September 7th at 3 PM, aiming to demonstrate the strength of bolsonarism and gauge his electoral support ahead of the elections.

item.title: Alcolumbre: o pequeno gigante do Senado (por Roberto Caminha Filho)
item.description: Senate President Alcolumbre criticizes ministers and politicians linked to corruption and political funding scandals, sparking intense backlash. The author depicts Brazil's 2026 political crisis, marked by accusations, suspicions, and institutional wear, particularly involving Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Com crise Moraes-Vorcaro, Fachin é único ministro do STF no 7 de Setembro
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin was the only minister present at the September 7th parade in Brasília, as the Court faces a crisis triggered by leaked messages between Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. No other minister joined the honor tribune, breaking usual protocol. The crisis involves allegations of favoring an investigation target and pressuring federal authorities.

item.title: Lula reúne Fachin, Alcolumbre e Motta em 7 de Setembro com gritos do público pelo fim da escala 6x1
item.description: President Lula participated in the September 7th parade with the heads of the three powers, including the STF president, Edson Fachin, during a crisis at the court. The public demanded the end of the 6x1 shift during the event.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta segunda-feira 7
item.description: On Monday, September 7, Brazil's Independence Day holiday, presidential candidates follow various agendas, including political events and civic parades. Lula (PT) has no campaign commitments, participating in the Brasília parade as president. Other candidates such as Flávio Bolsonaro, Zema and Caiado hold rallies in São Paulo and Goiânia.

item.title: Janja usa vestido de R$ 2.360 no desfile de 7 de Setembro
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva wore a R$2,360 dress from the Marie Mercié brand during the September 7 civic-military parade in Brasília, accompanying President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the presidential Rolls-Royce. The ceremony highlighted sovereignty, domestic violence prevention, and public health, featuring characters like Zé Gotinha. The Pernambuco-based brand emphasizes local production, sustainability, and social inclusion through a free sewing school.

item.title: STF precisa diminuir o seu ímpeto, diz Augusto Cury
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) stated that the STF should reduce its role, criticizing the Court's overreach. He supports the impeachment of ministers and proposes an eight-year term for judges. Cury also mentioned talks with party leaders to form a government based on dialogue.

item.title: Lula e Janja desfilam no Rolls-Royce conversível; assista
item.description: President Lula and First Lady Janja rode in the presidential convertible Rolls-Royce during the September 7 civic-military parade in Brasília, a symbolically charged event focused on national sovereignty. The ceremony featured public school students, military forces, and themes such as combatting femicide and the 2027 Women's World Cup, costing R$5.74 million—33% more than previous years.

item.title: Nikolas compila notícias sobre Lulinha e anuncia série sobre filho de Lula
item.description: Federal congressman Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) released the first episode of a series about Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, Lulinha, son of President Lula, covering previously known investigations into his business trajectory without introducing new facts. Although investigations like Lava Jato were archived due to judicial decisions, Nikolas argues that political questions about Lulinha's businesses remain.

item.title: Como a Avibrás vai entrar no contrato milionário do Exército com israelenses após venda para Joesley
item.description: The Army Logistics Command is reviewing a proposal for Avibrás to join the contract for 36 VBCOAP-SR howitzers from Elbit, following acquisition by the Joesley brothers. The R$800 million project aims to rescue the company in judicial recovery, supported by the Defense Minister.

item.title: Apesar de decisivas nas eleições, mulheres ainda são minoria nas campanhas dos presidenciáveis
item.description: Despite representing the majority of the Brazilian electorate (52.84%), women remain underrepresented in the strategic teams of the 2026 presidential campaigns. Among the five candidates analyzed, Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 10 women in strategic roles, followed by Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado with six each. Lula’s campaign did not officially confirm the list of women on staff, though names were gathered through press research.

item.title: Desfile em Brasília tem Lula, Fachin, Alcolumbre e Hugo Motta no palanque
item.description: The September 7th parade in Brasília featured President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and prominent figures such as Supreme Court Justice Edson Fachin and Congress President Davi Alcolumbre. The event gathered political and judicial authorities on a podium at the Esplanada dos Ministérios, highlighting a tone of institutional balance. Meanwhile, opposition protests called for investigations into politicians involved in corruption cases.

item.title: Augusto Cury: os números do candidato nas pesquisas eleitorais da última semana
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) rose to third place in the September 1st week electoral polls, with percentages ranging from 7.8% to 11% across five institutes. His sharpest growth occurred at BTG/Nexus, jumping from 2% to 11% in one week. Despite the surge, a clear gap remains between Cury and the front-runners Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Lula: os números do candidato nas pesquisas eleitorais da última semana
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads the national election polls from last week, with percentages between 37% and 43.4% in the first round, ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). However, the advantage narrows in the second round, with a technical tie in four of the five polls. Only AtlasIntel shows Lula with a margin of error above Flávio in the second round.

item.title: 7 de Setembro: Acompanhe atos pelo País
item.description: On September 7th, the main presidential candidates used Brazil's Independence Day celebrations to hold campaign events, with Lula attending the official parade, Flávio Bolsonaro on Paulista Avenue, and Zema criticizing a Supreme Court minister. The Lula government emphasized increased defense spending, while Zema attacked judicial figures. Augusto Cury also held an event in Copacabana.

item.title: Lula participa de 7 de setembro com Fachin, Alcolumbre e Motta; evento terá recados sobre soberania e violência contra a mulher
item.description: President Lula attended the September 7th parade in Brasília alongside STF justices and congressional leaders. The event emphasized national sovereignty, violence against women, and preparation for the 2027 Women's World Cup. Lula reiterated Brazil's stance against foreign tariffs and sovereignty.

item.title: Ancelotti pré-convoca cinco jogadores do Cruzeiro para a Seleção Brasileira
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti has included five Cruzeiro players on the Brazil national team shortlist for post-2026 World Cup friendlies: Otávio, Jonathan Jesus, Zé Lucas, Matheus Pereira and Kaio Jorge. The list remains subject to final cuts, with the official squad announcement scheduled for Wednesday (9) at the CBF headquarters.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro bate recorde de desempenho digital mesmo sob pressão do Master, diz Datrix
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads the Datrix Index of Presidential Candidates with 46.08 points, increasing his advantage over Lula despite pressure from the Master case.

item.title: Comício de Flávio no 7 de Setembro em SP testa força do bolsonarismo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro holds a rally in São Paulo to strengthen the bolsonarismo movement, attacking the STF and Lula while trying to close the gap in polls. The event aims to mobilize supporters and boost the PL candidacy for the 2026 elections.

item.title: UnB acumula 38 processos em investigação por fraudes em cotas raciais
item.description: The University of Brasília (UnB) has accumulated 38 ongoing investigations into alleged racial quota frauds since 2022, with 16 opened in 2023 and only two active in 2025. Of the total 48 cases, only 10 have been resolved, none resulting in penalties. The slow investigation process and perceived impunity benefit fraudsters, according to specialist Kelly Quirino.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP no 7 de Setembro
item.description: On Monday, September 7, nine candidates for governor of São Paulo continue their electoral campaign agendas on the national holiday commemorating Brazil's Independence. Key activities include public events, campaign material recordings, and gatherings at major locations such as Avenida Paulista and Praça da Sé.

item.title: Cotado ao STF deve sediar evento com Janja no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva attends a ceremony at the Rio de Janeiro State Court focused on preventing femicide, alongside Rio's interim governor Ricardo Couto, who is being considered for a Supreme Court vacancy. The event brings together representatives from the three branches of government to discuss actions against violence toward women.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos candidatos ao GDF neste feriado da independência (7/9)
item.description: On the Independence holiday, GDF candidates follow busy schedules with events at the Esplanada dos Ministérios and 7 September celebrations. Celina Leão leads the agenda with activities in Brasília, while other candidates maintain public and political event participation.

item.title: Brasileirão: Vitória e Grêmio duelam para se afastarem do rebaixamento
item.description: In the 26th round of the Brazilian Championship, Vitória and Grêmio face off in Salvador with the same goal of escaping relegation. Both teams come off mixed results, with Grêmio in recovery and Vitória on a four-game losing streak. The match is strategically important for staying in the competition.

item.title: Tarcísio faz 56% das agendas de campanha na capital, onde perdeu em 2022
item.description: Tarcísio prioritized the capital in 56% of his campaign events, with 22 of 39 events in São Paulo, as he seeks re-election. He reinforced partnership with Mayor Nunes and launched allied candidacies, avoiding direct debates with Haddad.

item.title: Análise: vitória afirmativa sob chuvas e trovoadas em Belém decreta justa chegada do Flamengo à liderança
item.description: Flamengo secured a crucial 1-0 victory over Remo at Mangueirão, with a goal from Samuel Lino, and took the lead in the Brasileirão after the draw between Palmeira and Botafogo. The celebration in the rain symbolized the importance of the win for the club's campaign.

item.title: Eleições com IA, sim!
item.description: The TSE established criteria to identify deepfakes in the 2026 elections, defining them as AI-generated synthetic content capable of misleading voters. This regulation reflects the challenge of balancing technological innovation with democratic protection.

item.title: Com STF em crise, Moraes e demais ministros da Corte mais próximos a Lula devem faltar ao desfile de 7 de Setembro
item.description: Amid the STF crisis following the release of messages between Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, the justices closest to Lula — Moraes, Gilmar Mendes, Flávio Dino, and Cristiano Zanin — will skip the September 7 parade. President Lula, seeking distance from the scandal, will not speak at the event, which will focus on topics like national sovereignty and femicide prevention.

item.title: Elton John enfrenta problemas de saúde antes de retorno aos palcos; relembre quadro do cantor
item.description: Elton John has faced health issues including vision loss and joint problems, but he will return to the stage at Rock in Rio 2026 as his only performance in Brazil.

item.title: Lula reforça mote da soberania no 7 de setembro, e Flávio Bolsonaro renova ofensiva contra Moraes
item.description: Lula emphasizes flags such as sovereignty and combat against violence against women in the September 7 parade, while Flávio Bolsonaro leads a new offensive against Moraes, but avoids attacks on the STF as an institution. The date will be used as a strategic showcase for the final stretch of the presidential campaigns.

item.title: “Função pública não deve se orientar por amizades”, diz Messias
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias stated that public service should not be guided by personal relationships but by the Constitution and republican rules, amid investigations into possible political influence on the AGU's decision. He emphasized having President Lula's support to act independently.

item.title: Crítica: Black Eyed Peas mantém público dançando debaixo de chuva com penca de hits e brasileirices
item.description: The Black Eyed Peas delivered their second Rock in Rio performance, keeping the crowd dancing despite heavy rain with hits like 'Boom Boom Pow' and Brazilian classics like 'Eu só quero é ser feliz' and 'Rap das Armas'. The group paid tribute to Brazilian culture by featuring producer Papatinho on stage.

item.title: Candidatos à Presidência fazem campanha em 9 Estados no fim de semana
item.description: Presidential candidates campaigned across nine states over the weekend, addressing health, education, and security. Lula backed full-time schooling; Flávio Bolsonaro proposed prison expansion and labeled crime factions as terrorism; Augusto Cury emphasized SUS reform and telemedicine; Renan Santos campaigned in Pernambuco and Ceará.

item.title: Sem citar críticas em relatório da PF, Messias diz que função pública não se orienta por 'amizades' e afirma que tem respaldo de Lula
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias stated that public legal action must follow the Constitution rather than 'friendships', responding to criticism over his office's refusal to file appeals with the Supreme Court in the Banco Master and INSS fraud cases. He emphasized support from President Lula and defended the decision as based on technical-legal analysis, dismissing claims it was retaliation from the Federal Police.

item.title: Crise no Supremo movimenta Brasília em semana esvaziada no Congresso
item.description: The 2026 electoral week begins with a crisis at the Supreme Federal Court shaping the agenda in Brasília, while the National Congress remains hollow. Main presidential candidates hold public events during the Independence Day holiday, with President Lula attending official celebrations in Brasília and other candidates, such as Flávio Dino, active in São Paulo.

item.title: Em pronunciamento, Lula defende soberania nacional: 'Não seremos colônia de ninguém'
item.description: On the eve of Brazil's Independence Day, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva delivered a speech emphasizing national sovereignty and criticizing foreign interference, stating that Brazil will not be a colony of any nation. The address served as an indirect reference to relations with the United States, underscoring the importance of the country's strategic autonomy.

item.title: Flamengo aproveita empate do Palmeiras e assume liderança pela primeira vez neste Brasileirão
item.description: Flamengo took the lead in the 2026 Brasileirão for the first time after beating Remo 1-0 and the draw between Palmeiras and Botafogo, moving one point ahead of the second-placed team.
